About Mama Dee's

Danville, Pretoria · Est. in the community

Mama Dee's Fast Foods is a Danville institution located at 41 Dobbin Street, Pretoria. Known for hearty township flavours served fresh every day, Mama Dee has built a loyal following on the back of generous portions, real ingredients, and a menu that has something for everyone — from traditional pap & stew to loaded sphatlos, shawarmas, burgers, and crispy fat cakes.

The kitchen prides itself on quality and consistency. Every item is prepared fresh in-house with a standard 15-minute wait time. Whether you're grabbing a quick lunch, feeding the family, or ordering a combo deal, Mama Dee's has you covered.
